name: DMR Engineering Limited
summary: DMR Hydroengineering & Infrastructures Ltd. functions as an engineering consulting firm, delivering comprehensive services from initial concept development to final operational commissioning. The company's expertise spans various domains, including hydropower (encompassing small-scale projects), renewable energy, the construction of road and railway tunnels, water resource management, dams, barrages, weirs, mining operations, and urban infrastructure development. Founded on December 15, 2009, by Neelam Mittal and Subhash Chander Mittal, the company's headquarters are situated in Faridabad, India.
